spans.s:
r. 6th cl. (धियति)
To have or hold, to keep, to possess.
5th cl. (धिनोति)
1 To satisfy.
2 To go, to move.

(ओ ङ) ओ धीङ् r. 4th cl. (धीयते)
1 To contain, to hold.
2 To slight, to disregard or despise.
3 To accomplish.
With अन्तर्,
To disappear, to become invisible.

f. (-धीः)
Understanding, intellect.
E.
ध्यै to meditate, affix क्विप्, the final diphthong rejected, and the semi-vowel changed to its congener इ, which becomes long.
